_note: VK-TERRAIN-SKIRT (rung 4) crack-check seam poses. Author-new closeups across three seam classes the ladder doc calls out: (1) LOD0-band boundary (near_land_low's ground area pulled back just past the LOD0 patch edge so the frame straddles a lodStep==1/lodStep>1 seam), (2) band-band boundary between two different lodStep coarse bands (further pullback, same XY), (3) map edge (existing mc2_01 corner poses reused via mc2_01.json edge_fog_corner_southwest / cross_map_view cover map-boundary chunks already -- this file adds a LOWER-altitude closeup at the SW map corner specifically to inspect skirt/edge-stitch geometry at the map boundary, where GL's edge chunks have partial quad extents). Run with BOTH MC2_VK_TERRAIN_ALL_LODS=1 and MC2_VK_TERRAIN_SKIRTS=1 on the VK side; compare against GL (gate off) same-camera.

bookmarks._note: Further pullback from the same ground area: at this altitude the visible near-camera ring is already coarse (lodStep>1) and the frame spans into a SECOND, coarser band (lodStep steps again further out) -- the band/band seam class the ladder doc flags as the crack-risk case this rung didn't have before (VK now owns bands on both sides of that seam, where rung-3 had GL own everything past LOD0).
